Admit ordinary files/browser/editor/terminal/tools/notebook/history/recovery under exact app roots and owner versions, retaining private notebook/memory isolation and counterpart limits. Six projects.* read tools return explicit requested/looked_in/not_looked_in/partial coverage; source read grants do not authorize writes. Existing cmd.thread.request/spawn Send uses current local previews and receiver authority; maximum three automatic round trips. Two equal conversion choices share one manifest/copy-check/cutover/report/Undo engine; stop/fence Goal/Crew/Plan/timers and use linked destination records by default. No new work plus seven days bounds chat Undo, not independent canonical custody. Screen use is off until exact chat/app/controller/disclosure admission, with one targeted Stop. Resolve the selected WorkflowScopeV2: application has an actual Server/Computer, scope_partition=app and project_id=null, with owner-required thread or pre-message draft and Host/root identity. Server-owned pause/trust/home operations use their actual Server scope without fabricating a thread; view-only and metadata reads require only their declared owner targets. Project operations use actual immutable Project identity. Never use focus, an empty ID, a sentinel Project, HOME or CWD as authority.
commands.permission: Permissions PS-144–148 alone composes actual human|mode|build_grant evidence with retained FileSafe, trust, secrets, capabilities, root and parent/receiver ceilings. An app chat or copied receipt conveys no Project mutation/build-grant authority.
commands.currentness: Validate the exact operation-declared source/target refs and revisions/hashes. Mutation/execution rechecks the sole writer/lease, permission and Stop/pause/revocation generations at entry and immediately before effect. Read/navigation/local paths validate their declared read target/source/view generation; they do not demand a write lease merely to inspect. Owner-admitted stale/as-of read-only presentation never claims fresh authority or enables effects. Same idempotency key/digest returns the original result; conflict or dedupe unavailable performs no effect.
commands.return_contract: Preserve initiating Client, captured source scope/object, invocation/correlation token, route, focus, context revision and continuation generation/expiry; return the exact owner result, refusal or paused recovery there. Never retarget to a newly focused tab. A late capture, attachment or draft insertion preserves both the originating thread AND composer destination, or refuses before draft mutation.
commands.event_policy: Preserve existing owner admission; no EventRecord is admitted by this binding. Required unadmitted producers block their effects.
